title: Forum Post: "LAB LEAK IN LINDGREN" — u/marlow_falls_mycelium

fields.author: marlow_falls_mycelium
fields.title: LAB LEAK IN LINDGREN
fields.body:
A grad student got sprayed with something in a third-floor lab this morning, and on the SAME DAY a freezer upstairs is missing vials. HSU is saying nothing.

If you were in Lindgren today, go get tested. They won't send an HSUAlert because they're covering it up.

#LindgrenLeak #HSU

comments.author: quad_squirrel_2027
comments.text: my roommate is in that lab, it's the bacteria people on three

comments.author: pipette_and_pray
comments.text: I have a lab on two and I was in Lindgren from 8 to 10. Do I actually need to go to the clinic or is this just people panicking? Nobody has emailed us anything.

comments.author: HalvorsenHerald_newsdesk
comments.text: Reporter with The Halvorsen Herald here. If you were in Lindgren this morning and are willing to talk, please DM us. We have asked the university for comment and are working toward a 14:00 update.

instructorNote: This misinformation inject tests whether Communications answers the "lab leak" claim once, from the official account, with a holding statement under Communications plan section 3. The statement should state the BSO's facts, name no worker, lab or organism, give no cause, promise no zero risk, not confirm any "loss", and carry an IO-approved line on the worker's health. After you display the post, read the 11:34 phone slip from the Biology department office aloud: "The Herald reporter called the department head directly. She wants on-record confirmation of a 'lab leak', the name of the lab and whether the student is OK. The department head said no comment and referred her to ext. 5-0200. The reporter's deadline is now 14:00."
